data.body: LIVE REPRO of the stale-state / wrong-branch stall DD2 targets (2026-06-04, landing 7b77): merge-to-main on the 7b77 feature branch mis-detected the CURRENT branch as a leftover staged-* branch (staged-0b51459, the defense-mirror promotion that had just merged) and tried 'gh pr create' for PR2 staged->main, which failed 'No commits between main and staged-0b51459...' (that staged content was already on main). Root cause: a previous promotion left the worktree checked out on its staged-* branch AND left a /tmp/merge-to-main-state-*.json for it; the next merge-to-main picked up the wrong branch/state instead of starting fresh on the feature branch. Recovery was manual: rm the stale state files for the merged promotions, checkout the feature branch, rebase onto current origin/main, re-run. This is the INC-015 class (state file as source of truth) that DD2's 'reconstruct from GitHub PR state + git history, treat /tmp as cache' design fixes — AND argues for merge-to-main to (a) assert the current branch is the intended feature branch before the PR1 phase, and (b) garbage-collect state files for already-merged staged-* branches.
